name: Hallow's Eve
source:
My name's Eve, and today I say goodbye to this sleepy town before university calls. Fall brings it alive, with Halloween rushing closer each year. Summer's gone before I know it, but I always spend it with Hallow...

[From [url=https://onitekka.itch.io/hallows-eve]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我叫伊芙。今天，上大學之前，我要跟這座昏昏欲睡的小鎮道別了。秋天總給它帶來生機，萬聖節也一年年匆匆逼近。夏天總在我還沒回過神來時就過去了，而我每次都和哈洛一起度過……

［摘自[url=https://onitekka.itch.io/hallows-eve]itch.io[/url]］
